text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

text.KJV: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

text.KJV: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
text.ASV: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
text.WEB: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

text.KJV: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
text.ASV: And next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
text.WEB: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
text.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

text.KJV: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
text.ASV: And the tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
text.WEB: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
text.WEB: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

text.KJV: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
text.ASV: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.
text.WEB: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

text.KJV: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
text.ASV: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
text.WEB: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
text.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

text.KJV: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
text.ASV: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
text.WEB: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

text.KJV: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
text.ASV: And the tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
text.WEB: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

text.KJV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
text.ASV: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
text.WEB: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

text.KJV: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
text.ASV: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall set forth hindmost by their standards.
text.WEB: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

text.KJV: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses: all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

text.KJV: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
text.ASV: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set forward, every one by their families, according to their fathers' houses.
text.WEB: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

text.KJV: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
text.ASV: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
text.WEB: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

text.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

text.KJV: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
text.ASV: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests that were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
text.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

text.KJV: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
text.ASV: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the presence of Aaron their father.
text.WEB: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
text.ASV: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
text.WEB: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

text.KJV: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
text.ASV: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
text.WEB: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

text.KJV: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
text.ASV: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
text.WEB: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

text.KJV: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.ASV: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.WEB: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
text.ASV: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the first-born that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:
text.WEB: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:

text.KJV: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: for all the first-born are mine; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast; mine they shall be: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

text.KJV: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
text.ASV: Number the children of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
text.WEB: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

text.KJV: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
text.ASV: And Moses numbered them according to the word of Jehovah, as he was commanded.
text.WEB: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.

text.KJV: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
text.ASV: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
text.WEB: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

text.KJV: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
text.ASV: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
text.WEB: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

text.KJV: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
text.ASV: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
text.WEB: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

text.KJV: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
text.ASV: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
text.WEB: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

text.KJV: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
text.ASV: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
text.WEB: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

text.KJV: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

text.KJV: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
text.ASV: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
text.WEB: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

text.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
text.ASV: And the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
text.WEB: The prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

text.KJV: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
text.ASV: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
text.WEB: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
text.ASV: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
text.WEB: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

text.KJV: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
text.ASV: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
text.WEB: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

text.KJV: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
text.ASV: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
text.WEB: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

text.KJV: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
text.ASV: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.
text.WEB: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

text.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
text.ASV: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
text.WEB: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

text.KJV: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
text.ASV: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the screen, and all the service thereof.
text.WEB: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.

text.KJV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
text.ASV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, `and have' the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
text.WEB: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

text.KJV: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
text.ASV: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
text.WEB: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

text.KJV: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
text.ASV: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
text.WEB: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

text.KJV: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
text.ASV: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.
text.WEB: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

text.KJV: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
text.ASV: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all the service thereof,
text.WEB: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

text.KJV: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
text.ASV: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
text.WEB: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

text.KJV: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.ASV: And those that encamp before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.WEB: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

text.KJV: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
text.ASV: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
text.WEB: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

text.KJV: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel:
text.WEB: You shall take the Levites for me (I am Yahweh) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

text.KJV: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
text.ASV: and Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
text.ASV: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
text.WEB: All the firstborn males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
text.ASV: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above `the number of' the Levites,
text.WEB: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who exceed the number of the Levites,

text.KJV: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
text.ASV: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
text.WEB: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; after the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):

text.KJV: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
text.ASV: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
text.WEB: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

text.KJV: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
text.ASV: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;
text.WEB: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

text.KJV: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
text.ASV: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five `shekels', after the shekel of the sanctuary:
text.WEB: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

text.KJV: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
text.ASV: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers' houses,
text.WEB: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
text.ASV: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, `about' the most holy things:
text.WEB: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.

text.KJV: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
text.ASV: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it,
text.WEB: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

text.KJV: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
text.ASV: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
text.WEB: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.

text.KJV: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
text.ASV: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls and the cups wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall be thereon:
text.WEB: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

text.KJV: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
text.ASV: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof.
text.WEB: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

text.KJV: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
text.ASV: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
text.WEB: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lamp stand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

text.KJV: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
text.ASV: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.
text.WEB: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

text.KJV: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
text.ASV: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof:
text.WEB: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

text.KJV: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
text.ASV: and they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
text.WEB: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

text.KJV: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
text.ASV: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
text.WEB: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

text.KJV: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
text.ASV: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the firepans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and put in the staves thereof.
text.WEB: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

text.KJV: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp is set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
text.ASV: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil, the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, the sanctuary, and the furniture thereof.
text.WEB: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
text.ASV: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
text.WEB: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

text.KJV: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
text.ASV: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;
text.WEB: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;

text.KJV: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
text.ASV: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.
text.WEB: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
text.ASV: Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers' houses, by their families;
text.WEB: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
text.ASV: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
text.WEB: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

text.KJV: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
text.ASV: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
text.WEB: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
text.ASV: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever shall be done with them: therein shall they serve.
text.WEB: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

text.KJV: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
text.ASV: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.
text.WEB: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

text.KJV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.ASV: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.WEB: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

text.KJV: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
text.ASV: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers' houses;
text.WEB: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
text.ASV: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof,
text.WEB: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

text.KJV: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
text.ASV: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.
text.WEB: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.

text.KJV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.ASV: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.WEB: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

text.KJV: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
text.ASV: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers' houses,
text.WEB: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting:
text.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
text.ASV: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
text.WEB: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

text.KJV: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

text.KJV: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
text.ASV: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers' houses,
text.WEB: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,
text.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
text.ASV: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers' houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
text.WEB: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

text.KJV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.

text.KJV: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
text.ASV: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' houses,
text.WEB: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,
text.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
text.ASV: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
text.WEB: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

text.KJV: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

text.KJV: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
text.ASV: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers' houses,
text.WEB: All those who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

text.KJV: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,
text.WEB: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore,
text.ASV: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
text.WEB: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

text.KJV: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden. Thus were they counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
text.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead:
text.WEB: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has an issue, and whoever is unclean by the dead.

text.KJV: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
text.ASV: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.
text.WEB: Both you shall put male and female outside of the camp; that they not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

text.KJV: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
text.WEB: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty;

text.KJV: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
text.ASV: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.
text.WEB: then he shall confess his sin which he has done, and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

text.KJV: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
text.ASV: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made unto Jehovah shall be the priest's; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.
text.WEB: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

text.KJV: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
text.ASV: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.
text.WEB: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

text.KJV: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
text.ASV: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
text.WEB: Every man’s holy things shall be his: whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray, and is unfaithful to him,

text.KJV: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
text.ASV: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, and she be not taken in the act;
text.WEB: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

text.KJV: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
text.ASV: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
text.WEB: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she isn’t defiled:

text.KJV: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
text.ASV: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her oblation for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
text.WEB: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

text.KJV: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
text.ASV: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah:
text.WEB: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh;

text.KJV: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
text.ASV: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.
text.WEB: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

text.KJV: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
text.ASV: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and let the hair of the woman's head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.
text.WEB: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

text.KJV: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
text.ASV: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse.
text.WEB: The priest shall cause her to swear, and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

text.KJV: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
text.ASV: But if thou have gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband:
text.WEB: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband:”

text.KJV: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
text.ASV: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, Jehovah make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when Jehovah doth make thy thigh to fall away, and thy body to swell;
text.WEB: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

text.KJV: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
text.ASV: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, and make thy body to swell, and thy thigh to fall away. And the woman shall say, Amen, Amen.
text.WEB: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

text.KJV: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
text.ASV: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness:
text.WEB: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness.

text.KJV: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
text.ASV: and he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her `and become' bitter.
text.WEB: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

text.KJV: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
text.ASV: And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the meal-offering before Jehovah, and bring it unto the altar:
text.WEB: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

text.KJV: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
text.ASV: and the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
text.WEB: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

text.KJV: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
text.ASV: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her `and become' bitter, and her body shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
text.WEB: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled, and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away: and the woman will be a curse among her people.

text.KJV: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
text.ASV: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
text.WEB: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

text.KJV: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
text.ASV: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goeth aside, and is defiled;
text.WEB: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled;

text.KJV: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
text.ASV: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then shall he set the woman before Jehovah, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
text.WEB: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

text.KJV: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
text.ASV: And the man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.
text.WEB: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself unto Jehovah,
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

text.KJV: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
text.ASV: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
text.WEB: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

text.KJV: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
text.ASV: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the grape-vine, from the kernels even to the husk.
text.WEB: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

text.KJV: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
text.ASV: All the days of his vow of separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in which he separateth himself unto Jehovah, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
text.WEB: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled, in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

text.KJV: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
text.ASV: All the days that he separateth himself unto Jehovah he shall not come near to a dead body.
text.WEB: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

text.KJV: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
text.ASV: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation unto God is upon his head.
text.WEB: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation to God is on his head.

text.KJV: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
text.ASV: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
text.ASV: And if any man die very suddenly beside him, and he defile the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
text.WEB: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

text.KJV: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
text.ASV: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting:
text.WEB: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
text.ASV: and the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
text.WEB: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

text.KJV: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
text.ASV: And he shall separate unto Jehovah the days of his separation, and shall bring a he-lamb a year old for a trespass-offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
text.WEB: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

text.KJV: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
text.ASV: And this is the law of the Nazirite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tent of meeting:
text.WEB: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

text.KJV: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
text.ASV: and he shall offer his oblation unto Jehovah, one he-lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for peace-offerings,
text.WEB: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh, one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, and one ram without defect for peace offerings,

text.KJV: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
text.ASV: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings.
text.WEB: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal offering, and their drink offerings.

text.KJV: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
text.ASV: And the priest shall present them before Jehovah, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his burnt-offering:
text.WEB: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering.

text.KJV: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
text.ASV: and he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
text.WEB: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering, and its drink offering.

text.KJV: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
text.ASV: And the Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offerings.
text.WEB: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

text.KJV: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
text.ASV: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazirite, after he hath shaven `the head of' his separation;
text.WEB: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite, after he has shaved the head of his separation;

text.KJV: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
text.ASV: and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; this is holy for the priest, together with the wave-breast and heave-thigh: and after that the Nazirite may drink wine.
text.WEB: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. This is holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

text.KJV: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
text.ASV: This is the law of the Nazirite who voweth, `and of' his oblation unto Jehovah for his separation, besides that which he is able to get: according to his vow which he voweth, so he must do after the law of his separation.
text.WEB: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows, and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, besides that which he is able to get. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel: ye shall say unto them,
text.WEB: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

text.KJV: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
text.ASV: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee:
text.WEB: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

text.KJV: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
text.ASV: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
