text.WEB: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

text.KJV: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
text.ASV: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
text.WEB: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

text.KJV: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.
text.ASV: So shall they put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
text.WEB: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
text.ASV: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had made an end of setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, and all the furniture thereof, and the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them and sanctified them;
text.WEB: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

text.KJV: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
text.ASV: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes, these are they that were over them that were numbered:
text.WEB: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted:

text.KJV: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
text.ASV: and they brought their oblation before Jehovah, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.
text.WEB: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
text.ASV: Take it of them, that they may be `used' in doing the service of the tent of meeting; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
text.WEB: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

text.KJV: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
text.ASV: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
text.WEB: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

text.KJV: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
text.ASV: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
text.WEB: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

text.KJV: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.ASV: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
text.WEB: and he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

text.KJV: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
text.ASV: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged unto them; they bare it upon their shoulders.
text.WEB: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

text.KJV: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
text.ASV: And the princes offered for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their oblation before the altar.
text.WEB: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes gave their offerings before the altar.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, They shall offer their oblation, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

text.KJV: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
text.ASV: And he that offered his oblation the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
text.WEB: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

text.KJV: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
text.ASV: and his oblation was one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty `shekels', one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;
text.WEB: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

text.KJV: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
text.ASV: one golden spoon of ten `shekels', full of incense;
text.WEB: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

text.KJV: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
text.ASV: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb a year old, for a burnt-offering;
text.WEB: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

text.KJV: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
text.ASV: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;
text.WEB: one male goat for a sin offering;

text.KJV: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
text.ASV: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
text.WEB: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

text.KJV: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
text.ASV: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
text.WEB: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

text.KJV: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
text.ASV: he offered for his oblation one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty `shekels', one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;
text.WEB: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

text.KJV: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
text.ASV: one golden spoon of ten `shekels', full of incense;
text.WEB: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

text.KJV: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
text.ASV: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb a year old, for a burnt-offering;
text.WEB: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

text.KJV: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
text.ASV: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;
text.WEB: one male goat for a sin offering;

text.KJV: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
text.ASV: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Nethanel the son of Zuar.
text.WEB: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

text.KJV: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
text.ASV: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun.:
text.WEB: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun

text.KJV: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
text.ASV: his oblation was one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty `shekels', one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;

text.KJV: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spake unto him.

text.WEB: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the candlestick.
text.WEB: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

text.KJV: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof `so as to give light' in front of the candlestick, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
text.ASV: And this was the work of the candlestick, beaten work of gold; unto the base thereof, `and' unto the flowers thereof, it was beaten work: according unto the pattern which Jehovah had showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
text.WEB: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lamp stand.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
text.ASV: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
text.WEB: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

text.KJV: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
text.ASV: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of expiation upon them, and let them cause a razor to pass over all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
text.WEB: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

text.KJV: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
text.ASV: Then let them take a young bullock, and its meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil; and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.
text.WEB: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

text.KJV: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
text.ASV: And thou shalt present the Levites before the tent of meeting: and thou shalt assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel:
text.WEB: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
text.ASV: and thou shalt present the Levites before Jehovah. And the children of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites:
text.WEB: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

text.KJV: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
text.ASV: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Jehovah for a wave-offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Jehovah.
text.WEB: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
text.ASV: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and offer thou the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, unto Jehovah, to make atonement for the Levites.
text.WEB: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

text.KJV: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave-offering unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
text.ASV: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine.
text.WEB: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

text.KJV: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
text.ASV: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tent of meeting: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for a wave-offering.
text.WEB: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

text.KJV: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
text.ASV: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of all that openeth the womb, even the first-born of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
text.WEB: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

text.KJV: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
text.ASV: For all the first-born among the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
text.WEB: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

text.KJV: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel.
text.WEB: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
text.ASV: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
text.WEB: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

text.KJV: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
text.ASV: Thus did Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the Levites: according unto all that Jehovah commanded Moses touching the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
text.WEB: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

text.KJV: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
text.ASV: And the Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes: and Aaron offered them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
text.WEB: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

text.KJV: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
text.ASV: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Jehovah had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
text.WEB: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
text.ASV: This is that which belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service in the work of the tent of meeting:
text.WEB: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

text.KJV: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
text.ASV: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the work, and shall serve no more,
text.WEB: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,

text.KJV: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
text.ASV: but shall minister with their brethren in the tent of meeting, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charges.
text.WEB: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

text.KJV: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
text.ASV: Moreover let the children of Israel keep the passover in its appointed season.
text.WEB: “Moreover let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

text.KJV: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
text.ASV: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all the statutes of it, and according to all the ordinances thereof, shall ye keep it.
text.WEB: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season—according to all its statutes, and according to all its ordinances, you shall keep it.”

text.KJV: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
text.ASV: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
text.WEB: Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the Passover.

text.KJV: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And they kept the passover in the first `month', on the fourteenth day of the month, at even, in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
text.WEB: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

text.KJV: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
text.ASV: And there were certain men, who were unclean by reason of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
text.WEB: There were certain men, who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.

text.KJV: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
text.ASV: and those men said unto him, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season among the children of Israel?
text.WEB: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
text.ASV: And Moses said unto them, Stay ye, that I may hear what Jehovah will command concerning you.
text.WEB: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your generations shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be on a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

text.KJV: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
text.ASV: In the second month on the fourteenth day at even they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs:
text.WEB: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

text.KJV: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
text.ASV: they shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break a bone thereof: according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it.
text.WEB: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

text.KJV: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
text.ASV: But the man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people; because he offered not the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
text.WEB: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

text.KJV: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
text.ASV: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto Jehovah; according to the statute of the passover, and according to the ordinance thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one statute, both for the sojourner, and for him that is born in the land.
text.WEB: “‘If a foreigner lives among you, and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh; according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance, so shall he do. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner, and for him who is born in the land.’”

text.KJV: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
text.ASV: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony: and at even it was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
text.WEB: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony: and at evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

text.KJV: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
text.ASV: So it was alway: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
text.WEB: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

text.KJV: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
text.ASV: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.
text.WEB: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

text.KJV: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
text.ASV: At the commandment of Jehovah the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of Jehovah they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they remained encamped.
text.WEB: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

text.KJV: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
text.ASV: And when the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journeyed not.
text.WEB: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

text.KJV: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
text.ASV: And sometimes the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Jehovah they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed.
text.WEB: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

text.KJV: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
text.ASV: And sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they journeyed: or `if it continued' by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
text.WEB: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled: or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

text.KJV: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
text.ASV: Whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, abiding thereon, the children of Israel remained encamped, and journeyed not; but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
text.WEB: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

text.KJV: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: At the commandment of Jehovah they encamped, and at the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed: they kept the charge of Jehovah, at the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
text.WEB: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
text.ASV: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shalt thou make them: and thou shalt use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.
text.WEB: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

text.KJV: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And when they shall blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves unto thee at the door of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
text.ASV: And if they blow but one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
text.WEB: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

text.KJV: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
text.ASV: And when ye blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey.
text.WEB: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

text.KJV: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
text.ASV: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
text.WEB: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

text.KJV: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
text.ASV: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
text.WEB: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

text.KJV: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
text.ASV: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute for ever throughout your generations.
text.WEB: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

text.KJV: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
text.ASV: And when ye go to war in your land against the adversary that oppresseth you, then ye shall sound an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before Jehovah your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
text.WEB: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

text.KJV: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow the trumpets over your burnt-offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.
text.WEB: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.
text.WEB: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

text.KJV: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.
text.WEB: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

text.KJV: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
text.ASV: And in the first `place' the standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
text.WEB: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
text.WEB: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
text.WEB: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

text.KJV: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
text.ASV: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bare the tabernacle, set forward.
text.WEB: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

text.KJV: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
text.ASV: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
text.WEB: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
text.WEB: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
text.WEB: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

text.KJV: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
text.ASV: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and `the others' did set up the tabernacle against their coming.
text.WEB: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

text.KJV: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
text.ASV: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
text.WEB: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
text.WEB: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
text.WEB: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

text.KJV: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rearward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
text.ASV: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rearward of all the camps, set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
text.WEB: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ochran.
text.WEB: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

text.KJV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
text.ASV: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
text.WEB: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

text.KJV: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
text.ASV: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their hosts; and they set forward.
text.WEB: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

text.KJV: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, We are journeying unto the place of which Jehovah said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good; for Jehovah hath spoken good concerning Israel.
text.WEB: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

text.KJV: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
text.ASV: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
text.WEB: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

text.KJV: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
text.ASV: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou shalt be to us instead of eyes.
text.WEB: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

text.KJV: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
text.ASV: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what good soever Jehovah shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
text.WEB: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

text.KJV: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
text.ASV: And they set forward from the mount of Jehovah three days' journey; and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah went before them three days' journey, to seek out a resting-place for them.
text.WEB: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

text.KJV: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
text.ASV: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
text.WEB: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, O Jehovah, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
text.WEB: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

text.KJV: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
text.ASV: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Jehovah, unto the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.
text.WEB: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

text.KJV: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
text.ASV: And the people were as murmurers, `speaking' evil in the ears of Jehovah: and when Jehovah heard it, his anger was kindled; and the fire of Jehovah burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.
text.WEB: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

text.KJV: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
text.ASV: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto Jehovah, and the fire abated.
text.WEB: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

text.KJV: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
text.ASV: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of Jehovah burnt among them.
text.WEB: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.

text.KJV: And the mixed multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
text.ASV: And the mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
text.WEB: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

text.KJV: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:
text.ASV: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt for nought; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:
text.WEB: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

text.KJV: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
text.ASV: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all save this manna to look upon.
text.WEB: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

text.KJV: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the color thereof as the color of bdellium.
text.ASV: And the manna was like coriander seed, and the appearance thereof as the appearance of bdellium.
text.WEB: The manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like the appearance of bdellium.

text.KJV: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
text.ASV: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
text.WEB: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

text.KJV: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
text.ASV: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
text.WEB: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

text.KJV: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
text.ASV: And Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.
text.WEB: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

text.KJV: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favor in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Wherefore hast thou dealt ill with thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favor in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
text.WEB: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

text.KJV: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
text.ASV: Have I conceived all this people? have I brought them forth, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing-father carrieth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
text.WEB: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers?’

text.KJV: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
text.ASV: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
text.WEB: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

text.KJV: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
text.ASV: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
text.WEB: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

text.KJV: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
text.ASV: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
text.WEB: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with thee.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

text.KJV: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
text.ASV: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the Spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
text.WEB: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

text.KJV: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
text.ASV: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Jehovah will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
text.WEB: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

text.KJV: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
text.ASV: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,
text.WEB: You will not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

text.KJV: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
text.ASV: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
text.WEB: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

text.KJV: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
text.ASV: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
text.WEB: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

text.KJV: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
text.ASV: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
text.WEB: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Is Jehovah's hand waxed short? now shalt thou see whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

text.KJV: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
text.ASV: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Jehovah: and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.
text.WEB: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

text.KJV: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
text.ASV: And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
text.WEB: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

text.KJV: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
text.ASV: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but had not gone out unto the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
text.WEB: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested on them; and they were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

text.KJV: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
text.ASV: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
text.WEB: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

text.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
text.ASV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
text.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
text.ASV: And Moses said unto him, Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all Jehovah's people were prophets, that Jehovah would put his Spirit upon them!
text.WEB: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

text.KJV: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
text.ASV: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
text.WEB: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

text.KJV: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
text.ASV: And there went forth a wind from Jehovah, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day's journey on this side, and a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.
text.WEB: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

text.KJV: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
text.ASV: And the people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
text.WEB: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

text.KJV: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
text.ASV: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the anger of Jehovah was kindled against the people, and Jehovah smote the people with a very great plague.
text.WEB: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

text.KJV: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
text.ASV: And the name of that place was called Kibrothhattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.
text.WEB: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

text.KJV: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
text.ASV: From Kibrothhattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.
text.WEB: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

text.KJV: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
text.ASV: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
text.WEB: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

text.KJV: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
text.ASV: And they said, Hath Jehovah indeed spoken only with Moses? hath he not spoken also with us? And Jehovah heard it.
text.WEB: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

text.KJV: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
text.ASV: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.
text.WEB: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they three came out.
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

text.KJV: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
text.ASV: And Jehovah came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.
text.WEB: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

text.KJV: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
text.ASV: And he said, Hear now my words: if there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream.
text.WEB: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

text.KJV: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
text.ASV: My servant Moses is not so; he is faithful in all my house:
text.WEB: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

text.KJV: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
text.ASV: with him will I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the form of Jehovah shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?
text.WEB: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

text.KJV: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
text.ASV: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them; and he departed.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

text.KJV: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
text.ASV: And the cloud removed from over the Tent; and, behold, Miriam was leprous, as `white as' snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
text.WEB: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

text.KJV: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
text.ASV: And Aaron said unto Moses, Oh, my lord, lay not, I pray thee, sin upon us, for that we have done foolishly, and for that we have sinned.
text.WEB: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

text.KJV: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
text.ASV: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
text.WEB: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

text.KJV: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
text.ASV: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, Heal her, O God, I beseech thee.
text.WEB: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

text.KJV: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
text.ASV: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
text.WEB: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

text.KJV: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
text.ASV: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
text.WEB: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
text.ASV: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.
text.WEB: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

text.KJV: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
text.ASV: And these were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
text.WEB: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Joseph, `namely', of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

text.KJV: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
text.ASV: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
text.WEB: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

text.KJV: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
text.ASV: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way by the South, and go up into the hill-country:
text.WEB: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

text.KJV: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
text.ASV: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
text.WEB: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

text.KJV: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
text.ASV: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
text.WEB: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

text.KJV: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first ripe grapes.
text.ASV: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
text.WEB: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

text.KJV: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
text.ASV: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
text.WEB: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

text.KJV: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
text.ASV: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
text.WEB: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

text.KJV: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
text.ASV: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it upon a staff between two; `they brought' also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
