text.WEB: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

text.KJV: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
text.ASV: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
text.WEB: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

text.KJV: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
text.ASV: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
text.WEB: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

text.KJV: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
text.ASV: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
text.WEB: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

text.KJV: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
text.ASV: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us; and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
text.WEB: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

text.KJV: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
text.ASV: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, `and' very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
text.WEB: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

text.KJV: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
text.ASV: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.
text.WEB: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

text.KJV: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
text.ASV: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
text.WEB: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

text.KJV: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
text.ASV: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
text.WEB: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

text.KJV: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
text.ASV: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.
text.WEB: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

text.KJV: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
text.ASV: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
text.WEB: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

text.KJV: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
text.ASV: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
text.WEB: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

text.KJV: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
text.ASV: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!
text.WEB: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

text.KJV: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
text.ASV: And wherefore doth Jehovah bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
text.WEB: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

text.KJV: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
text.ASV: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
text.WEB: They said to one another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”

text.KJV: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
text.ASV: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of them that spied out the land, rent their clothes:
text.WEB: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

text.KJV: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
text.ASV: and they spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
text.WEB: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.

text.KJV: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
text.ASV: If Jehovah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it unto us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
text.WEB: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.

text.KJV: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defense is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
text.ASV: Only rebel not against Jehovah, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is removed from over them, and Jehovah is with us: fear them not.
text.WEB: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

text.KJV: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
text.ASV: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Jehovah appeared in the tent of meeting unto all the children of Israel.
text.WEB: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have showed among them?
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have wrought among them?
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

text.KJV: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
text.ASV: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.
text.WEB: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear it; for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;
text.WEB: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

text.KJV: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
text.ASV: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that thou Jehovah art in the midst of this people; for thou Jehovah art seen face to face, and thy cloud standeth over them, and thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
text.WEB: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

text.KJV: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
text.ASV: Now if thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
text.WEB: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

text.KJV: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
text.ASV: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
text.WEB: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

text.KJV: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
text.ASV: And now, I pray thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
text.WEB: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

text.KJV: The LORD is long-suffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
text.ASV: Jehovah is slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression; and that will by no means clear `the guilty', visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.
text.WEB: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

text.KJV: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
text.ASV: Pardon, I pray thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy lovingkindness, and according as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
text.WEB: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

text.KJV: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
text.ASV: And Jehovah said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
text.WEB: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:

text.KJV: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
text.ASV: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Jehovah;
text.WEB: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory;

text.KJV: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
text.ASV: because all those men that have seen my glory, and my signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
text.WEB: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

text.KJV: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
text.ASV: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that despised me see it:
text.WEB: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

text.KJV: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
text.ASV: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
text.WEB: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

text.KJV: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
text.ASV: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: to-morrow turn ye, and get you into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.
text.WEB: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
text.ASV: How long `shall I bear' with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
text.WEB: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

text.KJV: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
text.ASV: Say unto them, As I live, saith Jehovah, surely as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
text.WEB: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you.

text.KJV: Your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.
text.ASV: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, that have murmured against me,
text.WEB: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,

text.KJV: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.ASV: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.WEB: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

text.KJV: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
text.ASV: But your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have rejected.
text.WEB: But your little ones, that you said should be captured or killed, them I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

text.KJV: But as for you, your carcasses, they shall fall in this wilderness.
text.ASV: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
text.WEB: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

text.KJV: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcasses be wasted in the wilderness.
text.ASV: And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your whoredoms, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.
text.WEB: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

text.KJV: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
text.ASV: After the number of the days in which ye spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my alienation.
text.WEB: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

text.KJV: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
text.ASV: I, Jehovah, have spoken, surely this will I do unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
text.WEB: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

text.KJV: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
text.ASV: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
text.WEB: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,

text.KJV: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
text.ASV: even those men that did bring up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Jehovah.
text.WEB: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

text.KJV: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
text.ASV: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.
text.WEB: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

text.KJV: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
text.ASV: And Moses told these words unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
text.WEB: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

text.KJV: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
text.ASV: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we are here, and will go up unto the place which Jehovah hath promised: for we have sinned.
text.WEB: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”

text.KJV: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
text.ASV: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah, seeing it shall not prosper?
text.WEB: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

text.KJV: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
text.ASV: Go not up, for Jehovah is not among you; that ye be not smitten down before your enemies.
text.WEB: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

text.KJV: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
text.ASV: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned back from following Jehovah, therefore Jehovah will not be with you.
text.WEB: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword, because you turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

text.KJV: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
text.ASV: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
text.WEB: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

text.KJV: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
text.ASV: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who dwelt in that mountain, and smote them and beat them down, even unto Hormah.
text.WEB: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

text.KJV: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savor unto the LORD, of the herd or of the flock:
text.ASV: and will make an offering by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill-offering, or in your set feasts, to make a sweet savor unto Jehovah, of the herd, or of the flock;
text.WEB: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;

text.KJV: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
text.ASV: then shall he that offereth his oblation offer unto Jehovah a meal-offering of a tenth part `of an ephah' of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil:
text.WEB: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil.

text.KJV: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
text.ASV: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
text.WEB: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

text.KJV: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
text.ASV: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts `of an ephah' of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil:
text.WEB: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

text.KJV: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: and for the drink-offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
text.ASV: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace-offerings unto Jehovah;
text.WEB: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;

text.KJV: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
text.ASV: then shall he offer with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts `of an ephah' of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil:
text.WEB: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:

text.KJV: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: and thou shalt offer for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
text.ASV: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.
text.WEB: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

text.KJV: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
text.ASV: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
text.WEB: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

text.KJV: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
text.ASV: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; as ye do, so he shall do.
text.WEB: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.

text.KJV: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
text.ASV: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth `with you', a statute for ever throughout your generations: as ye are, so shall the sojourner be before Jehovah.
text.WEB: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.

text.KJV: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
text.ASV: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
text.WEB: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

text.KJV: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
text.ASV: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up a heave-offering unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
text.ASV: Of the first of your dough ye shall offer up a cake for a heave-offering: as the heave-offering of the threshing-floor, so shall ye heave it.
text.WEB: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

text.KJV: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
text.ASV: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.
text.WEB: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

text.KJV: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
text.ASV: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses,
text.WEB: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,

text.KJV: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
text.ASV: even all that Jehovah hath commanded you by Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
text.WEB: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;

text.KJV: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savor unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
text.ASV: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah, with the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof, according to the ordinance, and one he-goat for a sin-offering.
text.WEB: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering, and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

text.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
text.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their oblation, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, and their sin-offering before Jehovah, for their error:
text.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

text.KJV: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
text.ASV: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.
text.WEB: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

text.KJV: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
text.ASV: And if one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a she-goat a year old for a sin-offering.
text.WEB: “‘If one person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

text.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
text.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that erreth, when he sinneth unwittingly, before Jehovah, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
text.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs, when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

text.KJV: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
text.ASV: Ye shall have one law for him that doeth aught unwittingly, for him that is home-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
text.WEB: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

text.KJV: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
text.ASV: But the soul that doeth aught with a high hand, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, the same blasphemeth Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
text.WEB: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, the same blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

text.KJV: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
text.ASV: Because he hath despised the word of Jehovah, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
text.WEB: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

text.KJV: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
text.ASV: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.
text.WEB: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

text.KJV: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
text.ASV: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
text.WEB: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

text.KJV: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
text.ASV: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
text.WEB: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

text.KJV: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of each border a cord of blue:
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue:

text.KJV: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
text.ASV: and it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Jehovah, and do them; and that ye follow not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to play the harlot;
text.WEB: and it shall be to you for a fringe, that you may look on it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’ t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to play the prostitute;

text.KJV: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
text.ASV: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
text.WEB: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

text.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

text.KJV: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
text.ASV: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took `men':
text.WEB: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

text.KJV: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
text.ASV: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;
text.WEB: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

text.KJV: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
text.ASV: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Jehovah is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the assembly of Jehovah?
text.WEB: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”

text.KJV: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
text.ASV: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
text.WEB: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

text.KJV: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
text.ASV: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, In the morning Jehovah will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he shall choose will he cause to come near unto him.
text.WEB: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

text.KJV: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
text.ASV: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
text.WEB: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;

text.KJV: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
text.ASV: and put fire in them, and put incense upon them before Jehovah to-morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he `shall be' holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
text.WEB: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:
text.WEB: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

text.KJV: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
text.ASV: `seemeth it but' a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them;
text.WEB: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

text.KJV: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
text.ASV: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?
text.WEB: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

text.KJV: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
text.ASV: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?
text.WEB: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you murmur against him?”

text.KJV: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
text.ASV: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, We will not come up:
text.WEB: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

text.KJV: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
text.ASV: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but thou must needs make thyself also a prince over us?
text.WEB: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

text.KJV: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
text.ASV: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
text.WEB: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

text.KJV: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
text.ASV: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Jehovah, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
text.WEB: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:
text.WEB: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

text.KJV: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
text.ASV: and take ye every man his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring ye before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.
text.WEB: Each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”

text.KJV: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
text.ASV: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
text.WEB: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

text.KJV: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
text.ASV: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the congregation.
text.WEB: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
text.ASV: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
text.WEB: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

text.KJV: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
text.ASV: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
text.WEB: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
text.ASV: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
text.WEB: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

text.KJV: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
text.ASV: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
text.WEB: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

text.KJV: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
text.ASV: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
text.WEB: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

text.KJV: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
text.ASV: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.
text.WEB: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

text.KJV: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
text.ASV: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah hath sent me to do all these works; for `I have' not `done them' of mine own mind.
text.WEB: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

text.KJV: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
text.ASV: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Jehovah hath not sent me.
text.WEB: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

text.KJV: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
text.ASV: But if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then ye shall understand that these men have despised Jehovah.
text.WEB: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up, with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
text.ASV: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;
text.WEB: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

text.KJV: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
text.ASV: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
text.WEB: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

text.KJV: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
text.ASV: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.
text.WEB: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

text.KJV: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
text.ASV: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.
text.WEB: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

text.KJV: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
text.ASV: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.
text.WEB: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
text.ASV: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are holy,
text.WEB: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

text.KJV: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
text.ASV: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Jehovah; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
text.WEB: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

text.KJV: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
text.ASV: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
text.WEB: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

text.KJV: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, that is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to burn incense before Jehovah; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Jehovah spake unto him by Moses.
text.WEB: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah, and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

text.KJV: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
text.ASV: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.
text.WEB: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

text.KJV: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
text.ASV: And it came to pass, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.
text.WEB: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, They looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.

text.KJV: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
text.ASV: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
text.WEB: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

text.KJV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
text.ASV: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take they censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and lay incense thereon, and carry it quickly unto the congregation, and make atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah; the plague is begun.
text.WEB: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

text.KJV: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
text.ASV: And Aaron took as Moses spake, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
text.WEB: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

text.KJV: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
text.ASV: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
text.WEB: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

text.KJV: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
text.ASV: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.
text.WEB: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.

text.KJV: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
text.ASV: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.
text.WEB: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of them rods, one for each fathers' house, of all their princes according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

text.KJV: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
text.ASV: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers' houses.
text.WEB: You shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

text.KJV: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
text.ASV: And thou shalt lay them up in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
text.WEB: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.
text.WEB: It shall happen, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

text.KJV: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
text.ASV: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
text.WEB: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

text.KJV: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
text.ASV: And Moses laid up the rods before Jehovah in the tent of the testimony.
text.WEB: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.

text.KJV: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
text.ASV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and put forth buds, and produced blossoms, and bare ripe almonds.
text.WEB: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

text.KJV: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
text.ASV: And Moses brought out all the rods from before Jehovah unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
text.WEB: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that thou mayest make an end of their murmurings against me, that they die not.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their murmurings against me, that they not die.”

text.KJV: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
text.ASV: Thus did Moses: as Jehovah commanded him, so did he.
text.WEB: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we perish, we are undone, we are all undone.
text.WEB: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

text.KJV: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
text.ASV: Every one that cometh near, that cometh near unto the tabernacle of Jehovah, dieth: shall we perish all of us?
text.WEB: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy fathers' house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

text.KJV: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
text.ASV: And thy brethren also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou near with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall be before the tent of the testimony.
text.WEB: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

text.KJV: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
text.ASV: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the Tent: only they shall not come nigh unto the vessels of the sanctuary and unto the altar, that they die not, neither they, nor ye.
text.WEB: They shall keep your commands, and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they, nor you.

text.KJV: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
text.ASV: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
text.WEB: They shall be joined to you, and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

text.KJV: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there be wrath no more upon the children of Israel.
text.WEB: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given unto Jehovah, to do the service of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.ASV: And thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and ye shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
text.WEB: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, And I, behold, I have given thee the charge of my heave-offerings, even all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, as a portion for ever.
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

text.KJV: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
text.ASV: This shall be thine of the most holy things, `reserved' from the fire: every oblation of theirs, even every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering of theirs, and every trespass-offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
text.WEB: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

text.KJV: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
text.ASV: As the most holy things shalt thou eat thereof; every male shall eat thereof: it shall be holy unto thee.
text.WEB: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

text.KJV: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
text.ASV: And this is thine: the heave-offering of their gift, even all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.
text.WEB: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

text.KJV: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
text.ASV: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give unto Jehovah, to thee have I given them.
text.WEB: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
text.ASV: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring unto Jehovah, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.
text.WEB: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

text.KJV: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
text.ASV: Everything devoted in Israel shall be thine.
text.WEB: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

text.KJV: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
text.ASV: Everything that openeth the womb, of all flesh which they offer unto Jehovah, both of man and beast shall be thine: nevertheless the first-born of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
text.WEB: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

text.KJV: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
