text.ASV: And those that are to be redeemed of them from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).
text.WEB: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

text.KJV: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
text.ASV: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave-breast and as the right thigh, it shall be thine.
text.WEB: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

text.KJV: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
text.ASV: All the heave-offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto Jehovah, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Jehovah unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
text.WEB: All the wave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any portion among them: I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And unto the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
text.ASV: And henceforth the children of Israel shall not come nigh the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
text.WEB: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

text.KJV: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
text.ASV: But the Levites shall do the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
text.WEB: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

text.KJV: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
text.ASV: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a heave-offering unto Jehovah, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
text.WEB: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
text.ASV: Moreover thou shalt speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up a heave-offering of it for Jehovah, a tithe of the tithe.
text.WEB: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

text.KJV: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
text.ASV: And your heave-offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the grain of the threshing-floor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
text.WEB: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

text.KJV: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
text.ASV: Thus ye also shall offer a heave-offering unto Jehovah of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and thereof ye shall give Jehovah's heave-offering to Aaron the priest.
text.WEB: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

text.KJV: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
text.ASV: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave-offering of Jehovah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
text.WEB: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering of Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

text.KJV: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
text.ASV: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be reckoned unto the Levites as the increase of the threshing-floor, and as the increase of the wine-press.
text.WEB: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

text.KJV: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
text.ASV: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best thereof: and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.
text.WEB: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
text.ASV: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, `and' upon which never came yoke.
text.WEB: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

text.KJV: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
text.ASV: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
text.WEB: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

text.KJV: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
text.ASV: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
text.WEB: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

text.KJV: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
text.ASV: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
text.WEB: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

text.KJV: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
text.ASV: and the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
text.WEB: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

text.KJV: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
text.ASV: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin-offering.
text.WEB: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

text.KJV: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
text.ASV: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
text.WEB: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

text.KJV: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
text.ASV: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:
text.WEB: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

text.KJV: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
text.ASV: the same shall purify himself therewith on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
text.WEB: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

text.KJV: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
text.ASV: Whosoever toucheth a dead person, the body of a man that hath died, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
text.WEB: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

text.KJV: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
text.ASV: This is the law when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and every one that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
text.WEB: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

text.KJV: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
text.ASV: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
text.WEB: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
text.ASV: And whosoever in the open field toucheth one that is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
text.WEB: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

text.KJV: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
text.ASV: And for the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin-offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
text.WEB: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured into a vessel.

text.KJV: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
text.ASV: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:
text.WEB: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

text.KJV: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
text.ASV: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
text.WEB: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

text.KJV: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
text.ASV: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of Jehovah: the water for impurity hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
text.WEB: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

text.KJV: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
text.ASV: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them: and he that sprinkleth the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he that toucheth the water for impurity shall be unclean until even.
text.WEB: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

text.KJV: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
text.ASV: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
text.WEB: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

text.KJV: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
text.WEB: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

text.KJV: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
text.ASV: And there was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
text.WEB: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

text.KJV: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
text.ASV: And the people strove with Moses, and spake, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!
text.WEB: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

text.KJV: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
text.ASV: And why have ye brought the assembly of Jehovah into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our beasts?
text.WEB: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

text.KJV: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
text.ASV: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
text.WEB: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

text.KJV: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
text.ASV: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto them.
text.WEB: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
text.ASV: Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock; so thou shalt give the congregation and their cattle drink.
text.WEB: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

text.KJV: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
text.ASV: And Moses took the rod from before Jehovah, as he commanded him.
text.WEB: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

text.KJV: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
text.ASV: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; shall we bring you forth water out of this rock?
text.WEB: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

text.KJV: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
text.ASV: And Moses lifted up his hand, and smote the rock with his rod twice: and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their cattle.
text.WEB: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed not in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

text.KJV: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
text.ASV: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Jehovah, and he was sanctified in them.
text.WEB: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

text.KJV: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
text.ASV: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
text.WEB: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

text.KJV: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
text.ASV: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and our fathers:
text.WEB: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

text.KJV: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
text.ASV: and when we cried unto Jehovah, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border.
text.WEB: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

text.KJV: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
text.ASV: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy land: we will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go along the king's highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy border.
text.WEB: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

text.KJV: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
text.ASV: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against thee.
text.WEB: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

text.KJV: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go up by the highway; and if we drink of thy water, I and my cattle, then will I give the price thereof: let me only, without `doing' anything `else', pass through on my feet.
text.WEB: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

text.KJV: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
text.ASV: And he said, Thou shalt not pass through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
text.WEB: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

text.KJV: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
text.ASV: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
text.WEB: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
text.ASV: And they journeyed from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came unto mount Hor.
text.WEB: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

text.KJV: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
text.ASV: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
text.WEB: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

text.KJV: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
text.ASV: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor;
text.WEB: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

text.KJV: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
text.ASV: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered `unto his people', and shall die there.
text.WEB: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

text.KJV: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
text.ASV: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
text.WEB: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

text.KJV: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
text.ASV: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
text.WEB: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

text.KJV: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
text.ASV: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
text.WEB: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

text.KJV: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
text.ASV: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
text.WEB: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

text.KJV: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
text.ASV: And Israel vowed a vow unto Jehovah, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
text.WEB: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

text.KJV: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
text.ASV: And Jehovah hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.
text.WEB: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

text.KJV: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
text.ASV: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
text.WEB: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

text.KJV: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
text.ASV: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
text.WEB: The people spoke against God, and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loathes this disgusting bread.”

text.KJV: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
text.ASV: And Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
text.WEB: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

text.KJV: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
text.ASV: And the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, because we have spoken against Jehovah, and against thee; pray unto Jehovah, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
text.WEB: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh, and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a standard: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he seeth it, shall live.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen, that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

text.KJV: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
text.ASV: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it upon the standard: and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked unto the serpent of brass, he lived.
text.WEB: Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of brass, he lived.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.
text.WEB: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

text.KJV: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
text.ASV: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
text.WEB: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

text.KJV: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
text.ASV: From thence they journeyed, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
text.WEB: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

text.KJV: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
text.ASV: From thence they journeyed, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that cometh out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
text.WEB: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that comes out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

text.KJV: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
text.ASV: Wherefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, And the valleys of the Arnon,
text.WEB: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

text.KJV: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
text.ASV: And the slope of the valleys That inclineth toward the dwelling of Ar, And leaneth upon the border of Moab.
text.WEB: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

text.KJV: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
text.ASV: And from thence `they journeyed' to Beer: that is the well whereof Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
text.WEB: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

text.KJV: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
text.ASV: Then sang Israel this song: Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
text.WEB: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,

text.KJV: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
text.ASV: The well, which the princes digged, Which the nobles of the people delved, With the sceptre, `and' with their staves. And from the wilderness `they journeyed' to Mattanah;
text.WEB: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

text.KJV: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
text.ASV: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
text.WEB: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

text.KJV: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
text.ASV: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh down upon the desert.
text.WEB: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

text.KJV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
text.ASV: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
text.WEB: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

text.KJV: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
text.ASV: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn aside into field, or into vineyard; we will not drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's highway, until we have passed thy border.
text.WEB: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

text.KJV: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
text.ASV: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz; and he fought against Israel.
text.WEB: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

text.KJV: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
text.ASV: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon unto the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
text.WEB: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

text.KJV: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
text.ASV: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the towns thereof.
text.WEB: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

text.KJV: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
text.ASV: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto the Arnon.
text.WEB: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

text.KJV: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
text.ASV: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come ye to Heshbon; Let the city of Sihon be built and established:
text.WEB: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

text.KJV: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
text.ASV: For a fire is gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
text.WEB: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

text.KJV: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
text.ASV: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
text.WEB: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

text.KJV: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
text.ASV: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid waste even unto Nophah, Which `reacheth' unto Medeba.
text.WEB: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

text.KJV: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
text.ASV: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
text.WEB: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

text.KJV: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
text.ASV: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took the towns thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
text.WEB: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

text.KJV: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
text.ASV: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
text.WEB: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

text.KJV: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
text.ASV: So they smote him, and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him remaining: and they possessed his land.
text.WEB: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
text.WEB: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

text.KJV: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
text.ASV: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
text.WEB: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

text.KJV: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
text.ASV: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now will this multitude lick up all that is round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
text.WEB: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

text.KJV: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
text.ASV: And he sent messengers unto Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me.
text.WEB: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

text.KJV: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
text.ASV: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
text.WEB: Please come now therefore curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

text.KJV: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
text.ASV: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
text.WEB: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

text.KJV: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
text.ASV: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Jehovah shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
text.WEB: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

text.KJV: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
text.ASV: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
text.WEB: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, `saying',
text.WEB: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

text.KJV: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
text.ASV: Behold, the people that is come out of Egypt, it covereth the face of the earth: now, come curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.
text.WEB: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse me them. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

text.KJV: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
text.ASV: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.
text.WEB: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people; for they are blessed.”

text.KJV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
text.ASV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land; for Jehovah refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
text.WEB: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

text.KJV: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
text.ASV: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
text.WEB: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

text.KJV: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.
text.ASV: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.
text.WEB: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

text.KJV: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
text.ASV: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
text.WEB: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

text.KJV: For I will promote thee unto very great honor, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
text.ASV: for I will promote thee unto very great honor, and whatsoever thou sayest unto me I will do: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
text.WEB: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

text.KJV: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
text.ASV: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah my God, to do less or more.
text.WEB: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

text.KJV: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
text.ASV: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what Jehovah will speak unto me more.
text.WEB: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else Yahweh will speak to me.”

text.KJV: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
text.ASV: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men are come to call thee, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak unto thee, that shalt thou do.
text.WEB: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

text.KJV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
text.ASV: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
text.WEB: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

text.KJV: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
text.ASV: And God's anger was kindled because he went; and the angel of Jehovah placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
text.WEB: God’s anger burned because he went; and Yahweh’s angel placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

text.KJV: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
text.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
text.WEB: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

text.KJV: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
text.ASV: Then the angel of Jehovah stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
text.WEB: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

text.KJV: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
text.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
text.WEB: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

text.KJV: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
text.ASV: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with his staff.
text.WEB: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

text.KJV: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
text.ASV: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
text.WEB: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me, I would there were a sword in my hand, for now I had killed thee.
text.WEB: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

text.KJV: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
text.ASV: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden all thy life long unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.
text.WEB: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

text.KJV: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
text.ASV: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Jehovah standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.
text.WEB: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I am come forth for an adversary, because thy way is perverse before me:
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

text.KJV: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
text.ASV: and the ass saw me, and turned aside before me these three times: unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I had even slain thee, and saved her alive.
text.WEB: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto the angel of Jehovah, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
text.WEB: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

text.KJV: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
text.ASV: And the angel of Jehovah said unto Balaam, Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

text.KJV: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
text.ASV: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.
text.WEB: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

text.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honor?
text.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honor?
text.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to speak anything? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
text.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.”

text.KJV: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
text.ASV: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kiriath-huzoth.
text.WEB: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

text.KJV: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
text.ASV: And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
text.WEB: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

text.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
text.ASV: And it came to pass in the morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from thence the utmost part of the people.
text.WEB: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
text.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

text.KJV: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
text.ASV: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
text.WEB: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he showeth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt-offering, and I will go: peradventure Jehovah will come to meet me; and whatsoever he showeth me I will tell thee. And he went to a bare height.
text.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

text.KJV: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
text.ASV: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
text.WEB: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

text.KJV: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
text.ASV: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
text.WEB: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

text.KJV: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
text.ASV: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
text.WEB: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

text.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
text.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, From Aram hath Balak brought me, The king of Moab from the mountains of the East: Come, curse me Jacob, And come, defy Israel.
text.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

text.KJV: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
text.ASV: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? And how shall I defy, whom Jehovah hath not defied?
text.WEB: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

text.KJV: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
text.ASV: For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him: lo, it is a people that dwelleth alone, And shall not be reckoned among the nations.
text.WEB: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

text.KJV: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
text.ASV: Who can count the dust of Jacob, Or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my last end be like his!
text.WEB: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

text.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
text.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
text.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

text.KJV: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
text.ASV: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah putteth in my mouth?
text.WEB: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

text.KJV: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
text.ASV: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them; thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
text.WEB: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

text.KJV: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
text.ASV: And he took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
text.WEB: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

text.KJV: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
text.ASV: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, while I meet `Jehovah' yonder.
text.WEB: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

text.KJV: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
text.ASV: And Jehovah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.
text.WEB: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

text.KJV: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
text.ASV: And he came to him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath Jehovah spoken?
text.WEB: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

text.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
text.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; Hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
text.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

text.KJV: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
text.ASV: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?
text.WEB: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?

text.KJV: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
text.ASV: Behold, I have received `commandment' to bless: And he hath blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
text.WEB: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

text.KJV: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
text.ASV: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob; Neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: Jehovah his God is with him, And the shout of a king is among them.
text.WEB: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

text.KJV: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
text.ASV: God bringeth them forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox.
text.WEB: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

text.KJV: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
text.ASV: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel: Now shalt it be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
text.WEB: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

text.KJV: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
text.ASV: Behold, the people riseth up as a lioness, And as a lion doth he lift himself up: He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, And drink the blood of the slain.
text.WEB: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

text.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
text.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
text.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

text.KJV: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
text.ASV: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that Jehovah speaketh, that I must do?
text.WEB: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”

text.KJV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
text.ASV: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come now, I will take thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
text.WEB: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

text.KJV: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
text.ASV: And Balak took Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh down upon the desert.
text.WEB: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
text.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

text.KJV: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
