text.ASV: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar.
text.WEB: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

text.KJV: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
text.ASV: And when Balaam saw that it pleased Jehovah to bless Israel, he went not, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
text.WEB: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

text.KJV: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
text.ASV: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
text.WEB: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

text.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
text.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;
text.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

text.KJV: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
text.ASV: He saith, who heareth the words of God, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
text.WEB: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

text.KJV: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
text.ASV: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, Thy tabernacles, O Israel!
text.WEB: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your tents, Israel!

text.KJV: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
text.ASV: As valleys are they spread forth, As gardens by the river-side, As lign-aloes which Jehovah hath planted, As cedar-trees beside the waters.
text.WEB: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

text.KJV: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
text.ASV: Water shall flow from his buckets, And his seed shall be in many waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.
text.WEB: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

text.KJV: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
text.ASV: God bringeth him forth out of Egypt; He hath as it were the strength of the wild-ox: He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, And shall break their bones in pieces, And smite `them' through with his arrows.
text.WEB: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

text.KJV: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
text.ASV: He couched, he lay down as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Blessed be every one that blesseth thee, And cursed be every one that curseth thee.
text.WEB: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

text.KJV: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
text.ASV: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together; and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
text.WEB: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

text.KJV: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honor; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honor.
text.ASV: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honor; but, lo, Jehovah hath kept thee back from honor.
text.WEB: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

text.KJV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
text.ASV: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers that thou sentest unto me, saying,
text.WEB: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

text.KJV: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
text.ASV: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Jehovah, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; what Jehovah speaketh, that will I speak?
text.WEB: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

text.KJV: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
text.ASV: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come, `and' I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
text.WEB: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

text.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
text.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;
text.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

text.KJV: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
text.ASV: He saith, who heareth the words of God, And knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
text.WEB: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:

text.KJV: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
text.ASV: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not nigh: There shall come forth a star out of Jacob, And a sceptre shall rise out of Israel, And shall smite through the corners of Moab, And break down all the sons of tumult.
text.WEB: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and break down all the sons of Sheth.

text.KJV: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
text.ASV: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession, `who were' his enemies; While Israel doeth valiantly.
text.WEB: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

text.KJV: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
text.ASV: And out of Jacob shall one have dominion, And shall destroy the remnant from the city.
text.WEB: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

text.KJV: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
text.ASV: And he looked on Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; But his latter end shall come to destruction.
text.WEB: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall come to destruction.”

text.KJV: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling place, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
text.ASV: And he looked on the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwelling-place, And thy nest is set in the rock.
text.WEB: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

text.KJV: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
text.ASV: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, Until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
text.WEB: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

text.KJV: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
text.ASV: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this?
text.WEB: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

text.KJV: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
text.ASV: But ships `shall come' from the coast of Kittim, And they shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber; And he also shall come to destruction.
text.WEB: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

text.KJV: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
text.ASV: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
text.WEB: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

text.KJV: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
text.ASV: And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to play the harlot with the daughters of Moab:
text.WEB: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

text.KJV: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
text.ASV: for they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods; and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
text.WEB: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

text.KJV: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
text.ASV: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.
text.WEB: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor. Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up unto Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may turn away from Israel.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
text.ASV: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that have joined themselves unto Baal-peor.
text.WEB: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

text.KJV: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
text.ASV: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;
text.WEB: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

text.KJV: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
text.ASV: and he went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
text.WEB: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
text.ASV: And those that died by the plague were twenty and four thousand.
text.WEB: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
text.ASV: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
text.WEB: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

text.KJV: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
text.ASV: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
text.WEB: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

text.KJV: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
text.ASV: and it shall be unto him, and to his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.
text.WEB: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

text.KJV: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
text.ASV: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.
text.WEB: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

text.KJV: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
text.ASV: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a fathers' house in Midian.
text.WEB: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
text.ASV: Vex the Midianites, and smite them;
text.WEB: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them,

text.KJV: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
text.ASV: for they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.
text.WEB: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

text.KJV: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
text.ASV: And it came to pass after the plague, that Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
text.WEB: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

text.KJV: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
text.ASV: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers' houses, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel.
text.WEB: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

text.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
text.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
text.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

text.KJV: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: `Take the sum of the people', from twenty years old and upward; as Jehovah commanded Moses and the children of Israel, that came forth out of the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
text.ASV: Reuben, the first-born of Israel; the sons of Reuben: `of' Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
text.WEB: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

text.KJV: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
text.ASV: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
text.WEB: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
text.ASV: These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
text.WEB: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

text.KJV: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
text.ASV: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab.
text.WEB: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.

text.KJV: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
text.ASV: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called of the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Jehovah,
text.WEB: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they rebelled against Yahweh,

text.KJV: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
text.ASV: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men, and they became a sign.
text.WEB: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

text.KJV: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
text.ASV: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah died not.
text.WEB: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

text.KJV: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
text.ASV: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
text.WEB: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

text.KJV: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
text.ASV: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
text.WEB: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

text.KJV: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
text.ASV: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
text.WEB: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

text.KJV: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
text.ASV: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
text.WEB: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

text.KJV: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
text.ASV: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
text.WEB: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

text.KJV: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
text.ASV: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
text.WEB: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
text.ASV: And the sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
text.WEB: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

text.KJV: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
text.ASV: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
text.WEB: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

text.KJV: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

text.KJV: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
text.ASV: The sons of Issachar after their families: `of' Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
text.WEB: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

text.KJV: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
text.ASV: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
text.WEB: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

text.KJV: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

text.KJV: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
text.ASV: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
text.WEB: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

text.KJV: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
text.ASV: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
text.WEB: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

text.KJV: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
text.ASV: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begat Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
text.WEB: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
text.ASV: These are the sons of Gilead: `of' Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
text.WEB: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

text.KJV: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
text.ASV: and `of' Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and `of' Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
text.WEB: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

text.KJV: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
text.ASV: and `of' Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and `of' Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
text.WEB: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

text.KJV: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text.ASV: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text.WEB: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

text.KJV: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of Manasseh; and they that were numbered of them were fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

text.KJV: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
text.ASV: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
text.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
text.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

text.KJV: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
text.ASV: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
text.WEB: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

text.KJV: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
text.ASV: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
text.WEB: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

text.KJV: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
text.ASV: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: `of Ard', the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
text.WEB: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

text.KJV: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
text.ASV: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
text.WEB: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

text.KJV: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
text.ASV: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
text.WEB: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

text.KJV: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
text.ASV: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
text.WEB: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

text.KJV: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
text.ASV: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
text.WEB: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

text.KJV: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
text.ASV: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
text.WEB: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

text.KJV: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.

text.KJV: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
text.ASV: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
text.WEB: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

text.KJV: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
text.ASV: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
text.WEB: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

text.KJV: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
text.ASV: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
text.WEB: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

text.KJV: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
text.ASV: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
text.WEB: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

text.KJV: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
text.ASV: To the more thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one according to those that were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.
text.WEB: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

text.KJV: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
text.ASV: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
text.WEB: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

text.KJV: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
text.ASV: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.
text.WEB: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

text.KJV: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
text.ASV: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

text.KJV: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
text.ASV: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath begat Amram.
text.WEB: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

text.KJV: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
text.ASV: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
text.WEB: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

text.KJV: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text.ASV: And unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
text.WEB: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

text.KJV: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
text.ASV: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Jehovah.
text.WEB: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And they that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

text.KJV: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
text.ASV: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
text.WEB: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

text.KJV: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
text.ASV: But among these there was not a man of them that were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
text.WEB: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

text.KJV: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.ASV: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.WEB: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

text.KJV: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
text.ASV: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
text.WEB: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

text.KJV: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
text.ASV: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the tent of meeting, saying,
text.WEB: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

text.KJV: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
text.ASV: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of them that gathered themselves together against Jehovah in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
text.WEB: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

text.KJV: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
text.ASV: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.
text.WEB: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

text.KJV: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
text.ASV: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.
text.WEB: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
text.ASV: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
text.WEB: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

text.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
text.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
text.WEB: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

text.KJV: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
text.ASV: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
text.WEB: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

text.KJV: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
text.ASV: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
text.WEB: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

text.KJV: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute `and' ordinance, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
text.ASV: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered;
text.WEB: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

text.KJV: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
text.ASV: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes. (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
text.WEB: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

text.KJV: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
text.ASV: And Moses spake unto Jehovah, saying,
text.WEB: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

text.KJV: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
text.ASV: Let Jehovah, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
text.WEB: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

text.KJV: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
text.ASV: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Jehovah be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
text.WEB: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

text.KJV: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
text.ASV: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
text.WEB: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

text.KJV: And thou shalt put some of thine honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
text.ASV: And thou shalt put of thine honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
text.WEB: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

text.KJV: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
text.ASV: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Jehovah: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
text.WEB: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

text.KJV: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
text.ASV: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
text.WEB: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.

text.KJV: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as Jehovah spake by Moses.
text.WEB: He laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savor unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
text.ASV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My oblation, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a sweet savor unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
text.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

text.KJV: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
text.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto Jehovah: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.
text.WEB: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

text.KJV: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
text.ASV: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
text.WEB: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;

text.KJV: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
text.ASV: and the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
text.WEB: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

text.KJV: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
text.ASV: And the drink-offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou pour out a drink-offering of strong drink unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

text.KJV: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meal-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
text.ASV: And on the sabbath day two he-lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts `of an ephah' of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:
text.WEB: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

text.KJV: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
text.ASV: this is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
text.WEB: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

text.KJV: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
text.ASV: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven he-lambs a year old without blemish;
text.WEB: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

text.KJV: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
text.ASV: and three tenth parts `of an ephah' of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for each bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;
text.WEB: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

text.KJV: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savor, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering unto every lamb; for a burnt-offering of a sweet savor, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
text.ASV: And their drink-offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt-offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
text.WEB: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

text.KJV: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
text.ASV: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
text.WEB: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

text.KJV: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
text.ASV: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Jehovah's passover.
text.WEB: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

text.KJV: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
text.ASV: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
text.WEB: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

text.KJV: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
text.ASV: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work;
text.WEB: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

text.KJV: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
text.ASV: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt-offering unto Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven he-lambs a year old; they shall be unto you without blemish;
text.WEB: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without defect;

text.KJV: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

text.KJV: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
text.ASV: Also when a woman voweth a vow unto Jehovah, and bindeth herself by a bond, being in her father's house, in her youth,
text.WEB: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

text.KJV: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
text.ASV: and her father heareth her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father holdeth his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
text.WEB: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

text.KJV: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
text.ASV: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and Jehovah will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
text.WEB: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

text.KJV: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

text.KJV: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

text.KJV: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

text.WEB: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.

text.KJV: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

text.KJV: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

text.ASV: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
text.WEB: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
