text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
text.ASV: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
text.WEB: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

text.KJV: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
text.ASV: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm ye men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Jehovah's vengeance on Midian.
text.WEB: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

text.KJV: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
text.ASV: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
text.WEB: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”

text.KJV: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
text.ASV: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
text.WEB: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

text.KJV: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
text.ASV: And Moses sent them, a thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
text.WEB: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

text.KJV: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
text.ASV: And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah commanded Moses; and they slew every male.
text.WEB: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.

text.KJV: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
text.ASV: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
text.WEB: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

text.KJV: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
text.ASV: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.
text.WEB: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

text.KJV: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
text.ASV: And all their cities in the places wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.
text.WEB: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

text.KJV: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
text.ASV: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of beast.
text.WEB: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

text.KJV: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
text.ASV: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
text.WEB: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

text.KJV: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
text.ASV: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
text.WEB: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

text.KJV: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
text.ASV: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
text.WEB: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

text.KJV: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
text.ASV: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
text.WEB: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

text.KJV: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
text.ASV: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

text.KJV: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
text.ASV: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
text.WEB: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

text.KJV: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
text.ASV: But all the women-children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
text.WEB: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

text.KJV: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
text.ASV: And encamp ye without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, ye and your captives.
text.WEB: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

text.KJV: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
text.ASV: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats' `hair', and all things made of wood, ye shall purify yourselves.
text.WEB: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”

text.KJV: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
text.ASV: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war that went to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses:
text.WEB: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:

text.KJV: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
text.ASV: howbeit the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
text.WEB: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

text.KJV: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
text.ASV: everything that may abide the fire, ye shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make to go through the water.
text.WEB: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

text.KJV: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
text.ASV: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
text.WEB: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
text.ASV: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers' `houses' of the congregation;
text.WEB: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

text.KJV: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
text.ASV: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation.
text.WEB: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

text.KJV: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
text.ASV: And levy a tribute unto Jehovah of the men of war that went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, `both' of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the flocks:
text.WEB: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

text.KJV: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
text.ASV: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for Jehovah's heave-offering.
text.WEB: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

text.KJV: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
text.ASV: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the flocks, `even' of all the cattle, and give them unto the Levites, that keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”

text.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
text.ASV: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
text.WEB: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

text.KJV: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
text.ASV: and threescore and twelve thousand oxen,
text.WEB: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

text.KJV: And threescore and one thousand asses,
text.ASV: and threescore and one thousand asses,
text.WEB: and sixty-one thousand donkeys,

text.KJV: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
text.ASV: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of the women that had not known man by lying with him.
text.WEB: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

text.KJV: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
text.ASV: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep:
text.WEB: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

text.KJV: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
text.ASV: and Jehovah's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
text.WEB: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

text.KJV: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and twelve.
text.ASV: And the oxen were thirty and six thousand; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and twelve.
text.WEB: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

text.KJV: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and one.
text.ASV: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and one.
text.WEB: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

text.KJV: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.
text.ASV: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Jehovah's tribute was thirty and two persons.
text.WEB: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

text.KJV: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And Moses gave the tribute, which was Jehovah's heave-offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
text.ASV: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided off from the men that warred,
text.WEB: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

text.KJV: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
text.ASV: (now the congregation's half was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
text.WEB: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

text.KJV: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
text.ASV: and thirty and six thousand oxen,
text.WEB: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

text.KJV: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
text.ASV: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,
text.WEB: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

text.KJV: And sixteen thousand persons;)
text.ASV: and sixteen thousand persons),
text.WEB: and sixteen thousand persons),

text.KJV: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, that kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
text.ASV: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;
text.WEB: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

text.KJV: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
text.ASV: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
text.WEB: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

text.KJV: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
text.ASV: And we have brought Jehovah's oblation, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, ankle-chains, and bracelets, signet-rings, ear-rings, and armlets, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.
text.WEB: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
text.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
text.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

text.KJV: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
text.ASV: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered up to Jehovah, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
text.WEB: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

text.KJV: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
text.ASV: (`For' the men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)
text.WEB: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

text.KJV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
text.ASV: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.
text.WEB: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

text.KJV: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
text.ASV: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
text.WEB: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;

text.KJV: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
text.ASV: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
text.WEB: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

text.KJV: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
text.ASV: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
text.WEB: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

text.KJV: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
text.ASV: the land which Jehovah smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle; and thy servants have cattle.
text.WEB: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

text.KJV: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
text.ASV: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.
text.WEB: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
text.ASV: And Moses said unto the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?
text.WEB: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?

text.KJV: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
text.ASV: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Jehovah hath given them?
text.WEB: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

text.KJV: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
text.ASV: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
text.WEB: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

text.KJV: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
text.ASV: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.
text.WEB: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

text.KJV: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah's anger was kindled in that day, and he sware, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

text.KJV: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
text.ASV: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
text.WEB: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

text.KJV: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
text.ASV: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.
text.WEB: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

text.KJV: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
text.ASV: And Jehovah's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Jehovah, was consumed.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight, was consumed.

text.KJV: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
text.ASV: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.
text.WEB: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

text.KJV: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
text.ASV: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.
text.WEB: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

text.KJV: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
text.ASV: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
text.WEB: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

text.KJV: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
text.ASV: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
text.WEB: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

text.KJV: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
text.ASV: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
text.WEB: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have each inherited their inheritance.

text.KJV: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
text.ASV: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.
text.WEB: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

text.KJV: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
text.ASV: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,
text.WEB: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

text.WEB: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

text.KJV: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

text.KJV: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
text.ASV: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah; and be sure your sin will find you out.
text.WEB: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

text.KJV: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
text.ASV: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
text.WEB: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

text.KJV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
text.ASV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
text.WEB: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

text.KJV: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
text.ASV: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
text.WEB: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

text.KJV: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
text.ASV: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.
text.WEB: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

text.KJV: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

text.WEB: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
text.ASV: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before Jehovah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

text.KJV: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
text.ASV: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
text.WEB: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

text.KJV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
text.ASV: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
text.WEB: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

text.ASV: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance `shall remain' with us beyond the Jordan.
text.WEB: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

text.KJV: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

text.ASV: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
text.WEB: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

text.KJV: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.

text.KJV: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

text.WEB: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

text.ASV: And they journeyed from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
text.WEB: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

text.ASV: And they journeyed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
text.WEB: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

text.ASV: And they journeyed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
text.WEB: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

text.ASV: And they journeyed from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
text.WEB: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

text.KJV: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
text.ASV: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured `stones', and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places:
text.WEB: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

text.KJV: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
text.ASV: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for unto you have I given the land to possess it.
text.WEB: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

text.KJV: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
text.ASV: And ye shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: wheresoever the lot falleth to any man, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye inherit.
text.WEB: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

text.KJV: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
text.ASV: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those that ye let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes, and as thorns in your sides, and they shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
text.WEB: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

text.KJV: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that, as I thought to do unto them, so will I do unto you.
text.WEB: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
text.ASV: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof),
text.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

text.KJV: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
text.ASV: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;
text.WEB: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

text.KJV: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
text.ASV: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;
text.WEB: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

text.KJV: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
text.ASV: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.
text.WEB: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

text.KJV: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
text.ASV: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the border `thereof': this shall be your west border.
text.WEB: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

text.KJV: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
text.ASV: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;
text.WEB: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

text.KJV: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
text.ASV: from mount Hor ye shall mark out unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;
text.WEB: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

text.KJV: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
text.ASV: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
text.WEB: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

text.KJV: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
text.ASV: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
text.WEB: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

text.KJV: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
text.ASV: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
text.WEB: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

text.KJV: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
text.ASV: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.
text.WEB: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

text.KJV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
text.ASV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which Jehovah hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
text.WEB: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

text.KJV: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
text.ASV: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers' houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:
text.WEB: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance.

text.KJV: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
text.ASV: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
text.WEB: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.ASV: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
text.WEB: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

text.KJV: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
text.ASV: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
text.WEB: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

text.KJV: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text.ASV: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
text.WEB: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

text.KJV: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

text.KJV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
text.ASV: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

text.KJV: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
text.ASV: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
text.WEB: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

text.KJV: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
text.ASV: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
text.WEB: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

text.KJV: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
text.ASV: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
text.WEB: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

text.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
text.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and suburbs for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.
text.WEB: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in. You shall give suburbs for the cities around them to the Levites.

text.KJV: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
text.ASV: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their substance, and for all their beasts.
text.WEB: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

text.KJV: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
text.ASV: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
text.WEB: “The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

text.KJV: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
text.ASV: And ye shall measure without the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
text.WEB: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the suburbs of their cities.

text.KJV: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
text.ASV: And the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which ye shall give for the manslayer to flee unto: and besides them ye shall give forty and two cities.
text.WEB: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

text.KJV: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
text.ASV: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities; them `shall ye give' with their suburbs.
text.WEB: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their suburbs.

text.KJV: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
text.ASV: And concerning the cities which ye shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many ye shall take many; and from the few ye shall take few: every one according to his inheritance which he inheriteth shall give of his cities unto the Levites.
text.WEB: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many; and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

text.KJV: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
text.ASV: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.
text.WEB: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

text.KJV: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
text.ASV: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.
text.WEB: The cities shall be to you for refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

text.KJV: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
text.ASV: And the cities which ye shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
text.WEB: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

text.KJV: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
text.ASV: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
text.WEB: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

text.KJV: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
text.ASV: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that every one that killeth any person unwittingly may flee thither.
text.WEB: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

text.KJV: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: And if he smote him with a stone in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: Or if he smote him with a weapon of wood in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
text.ASV: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.
text.WEB: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

text.KJV: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
text.ASV: And if he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,
text.WEB: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,

text.KJV: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
text.ASV: or in enmity smote him with his hand, so that he died; he that smote him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him.
text.WEB: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meets him.

text.KJV: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
text.ASV: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled upon him anything without lying in wait,
text.WEB: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

text.KJV: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
text.ASV: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
text.WEB: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

text.KJV: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
text.ASV: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;
text.WEB: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

text.KJV: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
text.ASV: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
text.WEB: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

text.KJV: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
text.ASV: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth,
text.WEB: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, where he flees,

text.KJV: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
text.ASV: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,
text.WEB: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

text.KJV: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
text.ASV: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.
text.WEB: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

text.KJV: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.ASV: And these things shall be for a statute `and' ordinance unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.WEB: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

text.KJV: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
text.ASV: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.
text.WEB: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

text.KJV: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
text.ASV: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
text.ASV: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
text.WEB: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

text.KJV: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
text.ASV: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
text.WEB: “‘So you shall not pollute the land in which you are; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

text.KJV: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in the middle of which I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell in the middle of the children of Israel.’”

text.KJV: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
text.ASV: And the heads of the fathers' `houses' of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers' `houses' of the children of Israel:
text.WEB: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
text.ASV: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
text.WEB: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

text.KJV: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
text.ASV: And if they be married to any of the sons of the `other' tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
text.WEB: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

text.KJV: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
text.ASV: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
text.WEB: When the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

text.KJV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
text.ASV: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.
text.WEB: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks right.

text.KJV: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
text.ASV: This is the thing which Jehovah doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.
text.WEB: This is the thing which Yahweh does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best; only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

text.KJV: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
text.ASV: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
text.WEB: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

text.KJV: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
text.ASV: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.
text.WEB: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

text.KJV: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
text.ASV: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave every one to his own inheritance.
text.WEB: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

text.KJV: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
text.ASV: Even as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
text.WEB: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

text.KJV: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
text.ASV: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons.
text.WEB: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

text.KJV: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
text.ASV: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
text.WEB: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

text.KJV: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
text.ASV: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded by Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
text.WEB: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
